: Doppler Systems is a company that develops and manufactures radio direction finding equipment.
Its products are used by the Federal Communications Commission (FCC), ports, and other entities to locate radio signal sources for enforcement and tracking purposes.
The company provides both fixed-site and mobile direction-finding units.
It also offers a user interface application for controlling and interacting with its radio direction finders.
: The company has recently provided radio direction finders to Ports Victoria in Australia and has also been selected by the FCC.
: Western Systems is an Indian-based company that provides a wide range of products and services for aerospace, defense, and research applications.
: Supplies cryogenically cooled low-noise amplifiers (LNAs) for deep space missions.
: Provides timing systems for satellite projects like Chandrayaan and Mangalyaan.
: Offers femtosecond laser-based products for research.
: Develops software for the design, analysis, and optimization of reflector antenna systems.
: The company is based in Bengaluru, India.
